environment.description: EKS pod running the stream processor with Kafka topic 'user-events' open to any authenticated Kafka producer. The Kafka cluster uses SASL/PLAIN with shared credentials distributed to multiple microservices. Any service with the shared credentials can produce messages to the topic. The downstream Lambda function URL (DOWNSTREAM_LAMBDA_URL) is configured with AuthType=NONE, allowing unauthenticated invocations. No input validation middleware or schema registry enforces message structure before consumption.

config.kafka_acl: allow all producers on topic user-events
